name: 113.2 — the ground an object stands on
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 113.2: gob:hitbox() answers a footprint of at least one polygon of at least three Positions sitting on the object, nil for a gone gob or one with no collision footprint, unchanged under gob:scale(k), absent from gob:info(), and gob:hitbox(1) raises naming arity. Paints every visible hitbox on the HUD for twenty seconds.
